results.title: How to support the application of multiple criteria decision ...
results.content: ## Omega. # Review How to support the application of multiple criteria decision analysis? https://doi.org/10.1016/j.omega.2020.102261Get rights and content. A taxonomy of characteristics for the multiple criteria decision analysis process is proposed. A harmonization of terminology for decision aiding components is advanced. Decision support systems for recommending decision analysis method(s) are reviewed. The research gaps for use of decision aiding in real-life studies are highlighted. ## Abstract. Multiple Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) is a process that has been used for several decades to support decision making. Over the last decades, many studies have demonstrated the conduct of the MCDA process and how to select an MCDA method. We then synthesize this research into a taxonomy of characteristics of the MCDA process, grouped into three main phases, (i) problem formulation, (ii) construction of the decision recommendation, and (iii) qualitative features and technical support. Additionally, we show how the DSSs for MCDA method recommendation can be grouped into three main clusters. ## Graphical abstract.
